method: Five isolated fresh accounts; four 30-minute sessions every six hours (two hours/day), one action opportunity per minute. Real server handlers, seeded random outcomes, calendar Sundays for everyone, normal detention/costs/ammo, daily and achievement claims. No PvP, casino, respect farming, team missions or external donations. Marriage purchased only once affordable; spouse supplies consent, no funding. Family founded and funded from earned money. Supporter packs renewed each 30 days in this comparison, including their stated cash/XP grants; live bots get only one month. Catalog-base asset valuation; purchases are cash outflow, not destroyed wealth. This is a strategy comparison, not a prediction or all-bonus maximum.
historicalRunNote: Completed before the cash-cap increase. Not rerun with the new cap.
